project.directory.description: Path to the root directory of the InSAR project containing inputs and outputs.

reference_date.description: Reference date for the time series in YYYY-MM-DD format.

reference_x.description: Reference X coordinate (UTM Easting or Longitude).

reference_y.description: Reference Y coordinate (UTM Northing or Latitude).

reference_pixel_index.description: Reference pixel row index (used if reference_x/y are not specified).

reference_pixel_column.description: Reference pixel column index (used if reference_x/y are not specified).

lookup_table.file.description: Path to the lookup table file for radar-to-geo coordinate conversion.

network.file.description: Path to the file defining the interferogram network.

phase.directory.description: Path to the directory containing interferogram phase files.

coherence.directory.description: Path to the directory containing coherence files.

mask.file.description: Path to the mask file to exclude noisy areas.

tropo.methods.description: List of tropospheric correction methods to apply (e.g., tropo_gacos, tropo_pyaps3).

tropo.gacos.files.description: List of GACOS tropospheric delay files.

tropo.pyaps.files.description: List of PyAPS weather model files.

velocity.method.description: Method for velocity estimation (ts2vel or ts2vel_robust).

inversion.max.iterations.description: Maximum iterations for time series inversion.

plot_coherence_matrix.description: Whether to plot the coherence matrix.

plot_network.description: Whether to plot the interferogram network.

output.format.description: Format of the output files (hdf5, netcdf, geotiff).

run.steps.description: List of specific steps to run in smallbaselineApp. If empty, all are run.
